# Anna's Archive

> > The world's largest open-source library aggregating LibGen, Sci-Hub, and Z-Library with free access to millions of books and scientific papers.

Anna's Archive is a digital preservation project that mirrors and provides unified access to major open-access book and research databases. The platform serves researchers, students, and knowledge preservation advocates by offering searchable access to scientific publications, books, and datasets through multiple formats including torrents and APIs.

## Key Topics

- Open-access
- LibGen
- Sci-Hub
- Z-Library
- SciDB
- Datasets
- Metadata
- Torrents
- Digital preservation

- Community contribution
- LLM training data
- Secret-key authentication
- DMCA
- WorldCat

## Core Services

- [Anna's Archive: LibGen, Sci-Hub, Z-Library in one place](https://annas-archive.gl): Homepage: world's largest open-source library mirroring LibGen, Sci-Hub, Z-Library
- [🧬 SciDB - Anna's Archive](https://annas-archive.gl/scidb): SciDB scientific database for open-access research resources and Sci-Hub
- [Datasets - Anna's Archive](https://annas-archive.gl/datasets): Open datasets from LibGen, DuXiu, Google Books, HathiTrust metadata
- [Torrents - Anna's Archive](https://annas-archive.gl/torrents): Torrent downloads for book archives and external collections metadata
- [LLM data - Anna's Archive](https://annas-archive.gl/llm): Machine learning training datasets and LLM data access

## Account & Authentication

- [Log in / Register - Anna's Archive](https://annas-archive.gl/account): User account login and registration with secret key authentication
- [Downloaded - Anna's Archive](https://annas-archive.gl/account/downloaded): User account page displaying downloaded items and membership status
- [Activity - Anna's Archive](https://annas-archive.gl/activity): User dashboard and activity feed for account management
- [Recover secret key - Anna's Archive](https://annas-archive.gl/account/recover-secret-key): Account recovery tool for retrieving lost secret keys

## Support & Documentation

- [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) - Anna's Archive](https://annas-archive.gl/faq): FAQ and help center covering common user questions and documentation
- [Improve metadata - Anna's Archive](https://annas-archive.gl/metadata): Guide for community contributions to improve metadata quality
- [Contact - Anna's Archive](https://annas-archive.gl/contact): Contact and support page with language selection and navigation
